perspective: Operator. Lane names are relative to the Harness. No broker, socket endpoint or HTTP server is implied.
schema_dialect: JSON Schema 2020-12; consumers MUST support the explicit schemaFormat. All references resolve within this document; network resolution is forbidden.
identity: Compare info.version and SHA-256 of the exact asyncapi.json bytes, not canonical JSON, package inventories, source commits or validator implementations. Existing package_version/package_digest fields carry this pair. Incompatible identities fail before execution.
fifo: Each message is four-byte unsigned big-endian length plus exact UTF-8 JSON. Control limit 65536 bytes; ordinary limit 4194304 bytes. Zero and oversized frames fail before allocation. Established peer loss is terminal; never reconnect or replay.
spool: Same JSON envelopes and lane limits. Ready names are 20 decimal sequence digits plus .json; temporary names prepend . and use .tmp. Publish by atomic rename without replacement. consumed.json in each control lane acknowledges captured ordinary and control positions cumulatively, with null initial positions; ACK is not execution confirmation. Sequence must match filename. Reject links, special files, gaps and duplicate publications. Preserve sequences across restores. Use bounded pending bytes and configured directory quota; cleanup removes transport files.
json: Reject duplicate object keys, invalid UTF-8, non-finite numbers and integers outside 0..9007199254740991 where counters are required. Object identity uses jcs-v1; byte identity uses raw SHA-256. Paths are NFC relative paths without traversal, empty components, links or casefold collisions.
startup: bootstrap, confinement_ready, initialize, initialized, admission_open; validate immutable launch, campaign, contract and input identities before opening admission. Complete manifests are read-only files at fixed mount paths; control messages carry verified descriptors rather than inline manifests. Transport control and ordinary lane sequences are independent.
correlation: Replies match campaign_id, launch_id, run_revision, call_id, operation_id and operation of the admitted request. Sequence is monotonically increasing per lane. Restores advance target revision and preserve Harness context; skip remaining calls in the accepted restore model batch.
admission: Validate typed request, lifecycle, configured limits, capability and campaign identity before effects. Product code assigns attempt bookkeeping. Origin is explicit: scenario requires a submitted scenario_id; exploratory forbids scenario_id. Persist effective input before target dispatch. Rejected submissions have no execution receipt.
duplicates: One durable operation identity cannot execute twice. Same identity and same command returns the saved result; changed command conflicts. Uncertain effects terminate without automatic retry or replay. Interrupted campaigns never resume.
evidence: Receipts are authoritative and category-specific. Validate campaign ownership, committed artifact purpose, digest, size, availability, visibility and byte ranges. Only inspected evidence may support claims. Readable handles and inspected-range citation handles are distinct; continuations preserve the readable handle and next offset. Never mark unread bytes inspected.
finish: One finish carries a bounded inline assessment or committed assessment artifact. Optional hypotheses/claims/history default empty; never invent them. Local hypotheses resolve regardless of array order; history is optional. Reject missing references, duplicates, self-parenting and cycles. Acceptance closes execution but is not proof of successful cleanup. Duplicate finish cannot duplicate effects. Assessment-unavailable preserves its reason and remains unsuccessful even with exit zero.
termination: Accepted finish plus verified exit zero can establish successful Harness execution. Unknown/nonzero exit, deadline, forced termination and cleanup failures remain distinct. Preserve primary causal diagnostics and secondary cleanup facts. Retain recovered rejection history without promoting it to terminal cause.
budgets: Host supplies configured operation timeouts and operational size limits at startup, within wire safety ceilings. Shorter request/campaign deadlines prevail. No target replay after timeout. Reservations are not confirmed usage. Insufficient model-token reservation reports allowance, consumed, remaining and next reservation, never unrelated evidence counters.
feedback: Native session profile stays native; effective Harness profile can narrow it. Expose only permitted selected observation kinds. Evidence absence/truncation is explicit, not success. Execution coverage is not evidence of objective achievement. Only independently validated, authorized tool operations may execute; model prose and provider metadata grant no authority.
image_compatibility: Local compatibility.json uses operator.dev/harness-compatibility/v1alpha2 with exactly api_version, contract_package_version, contract_package_digest, runtime_profile and platform. Match the interface version/hash before execution; runtime and native platform remain independently required. Product versions and source commits are provenance, not protocol admission gates.
corrections: Every correctable rejection identifies the model-facing field, schema or semantic rule, concrete correction, execution effect and resubmission safety. Schema constraint references identify installed schema nodes; reconstruct expectations from approved bytes, never trust submitted prose or values. Select alternatives by discriminators; ambiguous choices describe required fields. Unknown keys retain the nearest safe parent. Internal resolution failures are product errors, not requests for model-authored canonical identities. Preserve corrections across normalization and compaction. No-progress-limit reports consecutive turns without recognized progress and the observed/configured counts; preceding rejections remain distinct history.
model_relay: engine.model_generate accepts exactly purpose (generation or compaction) and conversation (an opaque provider-native JSON array). Operator constructs endpoint, credentials, model, prompt, tools, output allowance and all request options exclusively from host configuration. Conversation entries are never merged into request configuration. Compaction exposes no tools. Successful replies contain receipt_id, opaque response JSON, and host-validated context_budget; envelope identities provide correlation. Provider metadata does not alter interface compatibility. Host adapters validate only fields consumed for accounting; Harness adapters interpret completion and tool calls and validate actual requested Operator operations. Unknown usage retains reservations and cannot authorize continuation. JSON and whole-frame bounds remain mandatory.
